query_course_completion.description: When will a course's syllabus be finished at the current pace?

what_if_schedule_change.handler: ai_service: WHAT IF CANCEL (to be generalised)
what_if_schedule_change.description: Hypothetical: effect of cancelling/skipping/adding a class on pace or completion. Nothing is changed.

query_last_lecture.description: What was taught in a past lecture.

query_course_status.description: Progress / pace summary for one or all courses.

query_attendance_low.description: Which students are below the attendance threshold.

query_memory_events.description: Recall recorded academic events (cancellations, moves, etc.).

explain_delay.description: Why is a course behind plan.

cancel_class.description: Actually cancel a class. Needs confirmation.

reschedule_class.description: Actually move a class to a new date/time. Needs confirmation.

notify_batch.description: Send a message to a batch/course's students. Needs confirmation.

log_lecture.description: Record what was taught (topic, duration) for a course.

out_of_scope.description: Anything that is not an academic-workflow request. Must have NO entities.

entity_labels.COURSE: Course name/alias exactly as written: DBMS, AI, database, CSE-302
entity_labels.DATE: Date expression: tomorrow, Friday, 7 December, this month. In reschedule_class this is the ORIGINAL date.
entity_labels.TIME: Clock time: 10:00 AM, 3 PM. In reschedule_class this is the ORIGINAL time.
entity_labels.TOPIC: Syllabus topic: B+ Trees, BCNF, Normalization
entity_labels.DURATION: Length of time including the unit: 45 minutes
